assertions.assertion: Response explains the cookie extends because IdentityServer re-issues it via SignInAsync when the session's client list changes
assertions.rationale: It explains that with server-side sessions IdentityServer calls SignInAsync whenever the session's client list changes, re-issuing the cookie and resetting its expiration, and contrasts this with the set-once behavior without server-side sessions.

assertions.assertion: The web.app client sets UserSsoLifetime to an 8-hour value (28800 seconds) to force interactive re-authentication
assertions.rationale: web.app sets UserSsoLifetime = 8 * 3600 (28800 seconds), described as forcing interactive re-auth regardless of cookie renewals.

assertions.assertion: The client sets RefreshTokenExpiration = TokenExpiration.Absolute together with AbsoluteRefreshTokenLifetime to cap refresh-driven session extension
assertions.rationale: web.app sets AbsoluteRefreshTokenLifetime = 8 * 3600 and RefreshTokenExpiration = TokenExpiration.Absolute to hard-cap refresh-token-driven extension.
